check_power.question: Is the printer turned on?
check_power.help_text: Check the power button, display, and any status lights.

inspect_power.title: Check the printer power
inspect_power.instruction: Confirm that the power cable is securely connected and press the printer's power button.

turn_on_printer.title: Turn on the printer
turn_on_printer.instruction: Turn on the printer and wait until it finishes starting.

identify_connection.title: Identify the printer connection
identify_connection.instruction: Check whether a USB cable connects the printer directly to the computer. If no USB cable is present, the printer may use Wi-Fi or the local network.

check_usb.title: Check the USB connection
check_usb.instruction: Disconnect and reconnect the USB cable at both the printer and computer. Try another USB port if one is available.

restart_printer.title: Restart the printer
restart_printer.instruction: Turn the printer off, wait 30 seconds, and then turn it back on. Allow it to reconnect before trying again.

check_printer_status.question: Does the printer show a paper, ink, toner, or jam warning?

inspect_printer_display.title: Inspect the printer status
inspect_printer_display.instruction: Check the printer display and status lights for a paper, ink, toner, cover, or jam warning.

clear_printer_warning.title: Clear the printer warning
clear_printer_warning.instruction: Follow the printer's displayed instructions to add paper, replace ink or toner, close open covers, or remove jammed paper.

resolved.title: Printer operation restored
resolved.message: The printer appears to be working again.

advanced_diagnostics.title: Additional troubleshooting is needed
advanced_diagnostics.message: The basic checks did not restore printing. The print queue, default printer, network address, driver, or spooler service may require additional diagnostics.
